# 16 — Issue: End-to-end tests for the core journeys
State: open | Tags: story
URL: https://github.com/sthirion/pantry-pal/issues/16

## Description
**User story**: As the developer, I want end-to-end tests for the main journeys so that regressions are caught before they reach our phones.

Playwright setup against the real API and built frontend, personas, the main journeys, and a CI job.

**Scope**: test | **Effort**: L | **API contract**: all (real API)

**Implementation notes**: TASK-020. Page Object Model and personas per the test-e2e-patterns skill.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Given the E2E suite, when it runs, then it starts the API with a temporary SQLite database, seeded personas (two members of household A, one of household B), and the built frontend.
- Given Chromium (Pixel 7) and WebKit (iPhone 14) projects, then every journey passes on both: sign in and out, wrong password, create, rename, and delete a list, add, cross off, restore, rename, and delete an item, clear crossed off, choose a suggestion.
- Given the household B persona, then household A's lists are never visible.
- Given each screen, then an axe check reports no violations.
- Given a pull request, then CI runs the E2E suite in a separate job.

### 2 — Feature: Shopping Lists MVP (parent)
Self-hosted, ad-free shared shopping lists for one household (two users). Delivered as an installable PWA at `pantry.thirion.org`. The user stories for this feature are sub-issues of this issue.

## MVP scope

- Email and password sign-in; public sign-up disabled; accounts created by an admin command.
- Lists: create, rename, delete; home screen with the number of items left per list.
- Items: add, cross off, restore, rename, delete, clear crossed off; same name restores instead of duplicating.

### 33 — feat(14): suggest previously used items under the add field (related)
Adds item suggestions under the add field on the list screen as an ARIA combobox, matched locally so it works offline.

- Matches the start of the name or of any word, case-insensitive ("ic" matches "ice cream" and "iced tea", not "rice"; "cre" matches "ice cream")
- Shows at most 8 suggestions, ordered by use count, then most recent use

- **2026-11-21T18:38:47Z, sthirion**: ## Test Awareness Matrix

| Category                          | Applicable?    | Notes / What to Test |
|-----------------------------------|----------------|----------------------|
| **Unit Tests (Backend)**          | Not Applicable | This is an E2E story, not backend unit tests |
| **Unit Tests (Frontend)**         | Not Applicable | This is an E2E story, not frontend unit tests |
| **API Integration Tests**         | Not Applicable | This is an E2E story, not API integration tests |
| **E2E / Playwright Tests**        | Required       | All core journeys including sign-in/out, list/item management, suggestions, and accessibility checks must be tested across multiple browsers |
| **Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)**   | Required       | Axe-core checks must be run on each screen to verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance |
| **Translations / i18n**           | Recommended    | Check that localized strings are properly displayed in different locales |
| **Role-Based / Authorization**    | Required       | Test that users can only access their own household data and not cross-contaminate between households |
| **Security (OWASP)**              | Required       | Test that unauthorized access attempts fail appropriately |
